questions.stem_text:
The possibility that Homo erectus possessed an aesthetic sense and may have created "art"
is suggested by:

options.A: the size of their brains, with a mean brain size slightly larger than modern humans.
options.B: cave paintings and elaborate burials with numerous grave goods at the Trinil site.
options.C: recovery of a shell at the Trinil site with an intentionally engraved series of lines.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - recovery of a shell at the Trinil site with an intentionally engraved series of lines.

questions.stem_text:
The New World, "discovered" by Christopher Columbus, was filled with approximately how
many people?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - tens of millions

questions.stem_text: Pompeii was unusually well preserved because:

options.A: the layer of volcanic pumice created a seal over the remains.
options.B: avalanches pushed the remains into the sea and seawater preserves things.
options.C: poisonous volcanic gases killed people instantly.
options.D: the Romans embalmed the victims with salt from seawater.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the layer of volcanic pumice created a seal over the remains.
